answer: Give each identity a velvet-roped admission queue: to enter the market an agent must hold a live, expiring reservation token refreshed only by completing a fresh random task within minutes - a zephyr-fast check no batch script can precompute. The token price sits at its nadir only for agents with a long honest history; newcomers pay a steep bond that decays as they prove themselves. A farm running a thousand clones must staff a thousand live queues at once, paying the full bond and the constant attention cost for each, while one honest agent pays once and rides the cheap renewal.
